confirmation_policy: All periods are known Train development history. No Valid evaluation, Valid target, raw-target access, candidate score, freeze, or external submission. Phase 1 is a fixed descriptive diagnostic; Phase 2 requires a new experiment ID.

trials.comparison: Describe unmodified SN1_H1 quality and official portfolio attribution over fixed prior-only residual-volatility quintiles V1-V5.

feature_definitions.new_diagnostic_variable: VOL20[i,t] = sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of residual returns over the previous 20 stock observations ending at t-1.
feature_definitions.residual_return: raw_return_1day_train[i,tau] - beta_1day_train[i,tau] * topix_return_1day_train[tau], aligned on signal date using the current PIT input definitions.
feature_definitions.listing_gap: Use stock_comp_2026.strategies.dm_variable_box_breakout.features.segment_keys unchanged; rolling state resets after a gap greater than 20 market-date positions.
feature_definitions.rolling: Shift residual series one stock observation before rolling(window=20,min_periods=20); sample standard deviation ddof=1. No imputation; unavailable VOL20 rows excluded from V1-V5 and reported as VOL_MISSING for portfolio attribution.
feature_definitions.cross_sectional_rank: Within each signal date, average percentile rank over finite VOL20 only; quintile = clip(ceil(5 * percentile_rank) - 1, 0, 4), labeled V1 lowest through V5 highest.
feature_definitions.score_magnitude: Fixed near-zero split abs(SN1_H1 score) < 1e-12 versus >= 1e-12; no threshold search.
feature_definitions.boundary_sensitivity: Reuse deterministic Code perturbation: score + 1e-12 * daily cross-sectional score SD * u(Code), where u uses BLAKE2b digest_size=8 and key SN1-20260928; no magnitude or ordering search.

model: No model is fit for the diagnostic. Use exactly reproduced current SN1_H1 scores and official H1 Train targets; official portfolio membership and weights remain unchanged.
selection_rule: SUPPORT iff pooled RankIC(V1)>RankIC(V5) and Q5-Q1(V1)>Q5-Q1(V5), both comparisons hold in at least 3 of five complete years 2011-2015, and either annualized Short gross contribution(V5) is more negative than V1 or near-zero-score RankIC(V5) is lower than V1. MIXED if pooled primary directions are mixed or both align but stability/corroboration does not satisfy that rule. NOT SUPPORTED if neither pooled primary measure is in the predicted direction. Report all values; labels are descriptive and do not trigger strategy changes.
